referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A warm cafe template. A full-bleed coffee-bean photograph forms the masthead with a large thin display title and a simple four-link navigation. The opening is a split field: a cream text card with a short promise, a paragraph, and one amber button overlaps a wide photograph of a barista at work. A solid amber promise band follows with a centered cream card. A dark footer closes the page. Lora serif display, Raleway sans body, cream, amber, and coffee brown define the look.
